title: The portal and its neighbours
caption: The browser only ever talks to the portal (and, by navigation, to Stripe and the OTA admin). Every platform API call happens on the portal server; tokens never reach browser JavaScript.

nodes.label: Visitor / OTA member
nodes.detail: Signs up, manages an OTA, opens e-mail links from Mailpit (locally).

nodes.label: Caddy (platform.example.com)
nodes.detail: TLS, HSTS, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, sets `X-Request-Id` and the right-most `X-Forwarded-For`. Answers 404 for `/health/*` on the public host.

nodes.label: Portal server :3000
nodes.detail: Next.js 15 standalone server (`velexis-portal.service`). Middleware refreshes tokens; pages and server actions call the API.

nodes.label: Platform API :3100
nodes.detail: `/v1/**` operations of `velexis-platform-api.openapi.yaml`. Honours the end-user headers only with the BFF key.

nodes.label: Platform worker
nodes.detail: Sends e-mails from the outbox, follows Stripe events, verifies credentials and domains.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL (platform schema)
nodes.detail: `platform.*` tables written by the API, never by the portal.

nodes.label: OTA admin (admin.ota.example.com)
nodes.detail: Receives the hand-off `POST /sso` with `portalToken`; sends people without a session to `/console?tenant=`.

nodes.label: OTA worker
nodes.detail: Builds the tenant schema during provisioning (the set-up page waits for it).

nodes.label: Storefront
nodes.detail: Linked from the dashboard and overview (`https://<primaryHost>/`).

nodes.label: SMTP / Mailpit
nodes.detail: Verification, reset, invitation and welcome e-mails with links back to the portal.

nodes.label: Stripe
nodes.detail: Checkout, Customer Portal and Connect authorize pages, reached by top-level navigation only.

edges.label: REST /v1, Bearer from cookie, BFF headers
